title: kramastotra — kram-p25-v25
question: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force — body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing-formed. When time's cadre reaches Your dissolution-step — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
